$$
\iiint_\Omega(x^3+y+z)\,dv=\iiint_\Omega x^3\,dv+\iiint_\Omega y\,dv+\iiint_\Omega z\,dv=\iiint_\Omega z\,dv\quad\text{（前两项积分均为零）}
$$
而
$$
\Omega:\left\{\begin{array}{l}
0\leq\theta\leq2\pi\\
0\leq\varphi\leq\frac{\pi}{4}\\
0\leq r\leq\sqrt{2}
\end{array}\right.,\quad\text{于是}
$$
$$
\iiint_\Omega z\,dv=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_0^{\sqrt{2}}r\cos\varphi\cdot r^2\sin\varphi\,dr=2\pi\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin\varphi\cos\varphi\,d\varphi=\frac{\pi}{2}.
$$
